name: Ivan Petrov
biography: is a master student at Computer Systems Lab, Computer Science Dept. of Moscow State University, Russia. Ivan is an active member of Bushwhackers CTF team, which is the winner of iCTF competitions this year. Ivan works on shellcode-detection projects. His primary interests are mobile security and network security, including analysis of ARM-based malware. Twitter: _IvanPetrov_
